newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kansai Electric reactor back on line.
newsitem.headline: Kansai Electric reactor back on line.

text.p: Kansai Electric Power Co Inc said on Friday it restarted a 1.18 million kilowatt reactor at its Oi plant on the Sea of Japan on Thursday evening.
Power generation at the reactor is expected to resume at around noon on Friday, a spokesman for Kansai Electric said.
The power utility shut down the pressurised light-water reactor on August 25 due to an unusual rise in the temperature of a pump circulating coolant.
The firm later found out the temperature rise occured because a tiny piece of metal partly clogged a valve and cut the supply of water for cooling lubricant oil in the pump.
